review_description: Dick made every effort to make sure I understood the system and followed up on original quote. Was not the cheapest quote but close. Installers were good.

After Dick helped us with our purchase of a heat pump hot water system a few months ago, we were happy to consider Easter Suburbs Solar for our PV system. Wasn't quite the cheapest for the system on offer, but the difference was negligible when working with someone we already knew and who was patient with our questions and delays and very informative.When we finally made a commitment, it took less than two weeks to get the system installed - this in December, with the pre-Christmas (and pre-decrease-in-STCs) rush. The installation went smoothly, and looks neat. With the holiday period it took longer for our electricity retailer to arrange the new meter, so we've only been fully operational for a week so far, with a few overcast days, but averaged about 30kWh per day.

Excellent recommendation, knowledgeable and completed as promised. As a result have also installed new water heater with same company

Initial vetting and short listing of vendors by SolarQuotes gave me a greater confidence that I was dealing with reputable businesses. The subsequent time provided by ES Solar in discussing the options and multiple system sizing quotes was extremely helpful in making the final call to proceed.
